# Network Prerequisite Resolution

**The security group rules must be synchronized and iptables rules must be flushed and re-applied** on the Neutron network port (port-2352a566) before the VM instance becomes reachable. This requires the neutron agent to complete the iptables_manager refresh operation to ensure all security group rules are properly enforced at the network level.

**Recommendation:** Verify that the neutron-linuxbridge-agent (or equivalent) completes its security group rule synchronization by monitoring the agent logs until the "security group rule sync pending" warnings clear, then confirm VM connectivity.
